note_en: One-time recovery authorization at 09:16 ET supersedes the 09:00 HOLD only for one newly sealed Model T MU proposal. The earlier HOLD remains documented in Git history. No historical session is backfilled; execution is allowed only in today's real post-market window and only at or below the signed price ceiling.
